title: Linden Agent Bridge manifest
description: Endpoint + credential manifest written by Linden Engine so any MCP-capable agent can attach to the linden MCP server without manual copy/paste. Lives at <project>/.linden/agent-bridge.json (mode 0600, git-ignored); rewritten on every engine start and project switch.

projectPath.description: Absolute project directory the endpoint is serving.

endpoint.description: Loopback Streamable-HTTP MCP endpoint. Never bind a public interface.

protocolVersion.description: Newest MCP revision the server supports; clients may negotiate down to 2024-11-05.

tokens.description: Bearer tokens keyed by client id. The master token sees every tool; role tokens are restricted to scopes[roleId].

scopes.description: Tool names (no linden_ prefix) each role token may list and call. A role without an entry falls back to the engine's built-in role catalog.

bridge.description: Optional ready-to-spawn stdio bridge for clients that cannot speak HTTP headers.
